[NLFC.5.3] Drive time explicitly:

`ds_engine_clock_set` / `_advance` move the monotonic clock, `_advance` moves
the wall clock by the same interval, and `ds_engine_wall_clock_set` sets the
wall clock alone ([NTST.3.1]). All three return `DS_ERR_STATE` in live mode.

In live mode the wall clock comes from the host or, on a microcontroller, from
the board's optional wall-clock shim ([IARC.3.11.2]). An integrator gives a
clockless board its wall clock by implementing that shim, not by calling
`ds_engine_wall_clock_set`.
